text:
Grok Botting in the sky right now with Starlink.

Agents to build:

AEO/SEO bot - ingest your top content (sales calls/customer calls/pod/YT) then combine with ClickFlow API, GA4, Ahrefs API, GSC, etc. to draft to CMS on autopilot.

Deal desk - move the ball forward on all deals. Stalled, lost, lookalikes, etc. - just advance the damn work. Every day.

X longform writer bot - ingest your content and also leverage @mvanhorn last30days skill to pull the best stuff to post to X as longform articles.

Founder content radar - leverage said skill above and combine with @businessbarista content machine interview to hit the best angles. Never run out of content ideas.

Chief of staff bot - to coordinate all this stuff before it becomes a giant mess.

Btw you can get these skills in the link below.

What did I miss?
